title: Servo ID Setup Sequencer
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Robotics
description: Read the eight steps of giving one servo its ID, each with the reason it comes where it does. Then put eight shuffled step cards into the right order, with three attempts to get them all in place. Used in Chapter 8.

educational.topic: Setting servo IDs one servo at a time with lerobot-setup-motors
learningObjectives: Organize the eight steps of setting one servo's ID into their correct order, with at least 7 of the 8 steps in their correct positions within three attempts

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Order shuffled procedure cards by their dependencies, with a count of correct positions after each attempt and the reasons revealed at the end
keyQuestions: Which step must come before this one, and why?
What would go wrong if two new servos were on the bus at once?
commonMisconceptions: All six servos can be connected and given IDs together
The ID is lost when the power is switched off
The order of motors does not matter
assessmentOpportunities: One ordering exercise with up to three checked attempts; mastery is 7 or more of 8 cards in the correct position

controls.label: Tap a card to select it
